title.en: farm market on half street, till one.
title.de: bauernmarkt in der half street, bis eins.
title.tr: half street'te çiftlik pazarı, bire kadar.

line.en: the farm market on half street runs 9 to 1 until the 21st. eat something from a stall, then walk the row.
line.de: der bauernmarkt in der half street läuft von 9 bis 13 uhr bis zum 21. essen Sie etwas am stand, dann einmal die reihe ab.
line.tr: half street çiftlik pazarı 21'ine kadar 9'dan 13'e açık. bir tezgâhtan bir şeyler yiyin, sonra sırayı dolaşın.

sparks.why: Half Street Central Farm Market, 1250 Half St SE, 9am-1pm, season through Nov 21 (marketspread listing); the Saturday 14th comes from the search summary, not the listing itself.
